rationale: This round's blocker fix: on DIVERGED local/origin bases the resolver returns BOTH tips and the branch diff becomes their intersection, so no file outside the branch's real delta can be certified whichever base the merge lands on. Collapsing back to one tip restores the merge-mode-blind hole: the diverged-base and intersection cases go red (verified 77 pass / 3 fail mutated, 80 pass / 0 fail restored) while the reader suite, whose two base refs resolve to one sha so the divergence branch is never taken, stays green (30 pass / 0 fail under the same mutation).
